description: Check dimensions, then compare first-order GUM with seeded fixed-sample Monte Carlo for an explicit model of 1–16 inputs. Return uncertainty budgets, coverage intervals and convergence/linearization findings. Conditional on supplied distributions; no affine units. CPU, direct-only; no planner binding.

correlations.description: Correlations between normal inputs with standard_uncertainty > 0.

expression.description: Model with + - * / ^, parentheses, pi and sqrt exp ln log10 sin cos tan asin acos atan abs. Literals are dimensionless; no implicit multiplication.

result_unit.description: Output unit; must match the model dimension.

samples.description: Monte Carlo draws, default 1000000 (JCGM 101 typical value for 2 significant digits).

half_width.description: uniform and triangular only: half-width, in unit.

standard_uncertainty.description: normal only: standard deviation, in unit.

unit.description: e.g. mg, km/h, kg/m^3, W/m^2/K, deg, kWh, %. Empty means dimensionless. °C and °F are refused; use K.

name: propagate_uncertainty
title: Measurement uncertainty: GUM and Monte Carlo
